:::{#def-cv-se-indexed}
#### Fold-based standard error of a named procedure

The **fold-based standard error of procedure** $g$
is the [fold-based standard error](#def-cv-se)
computed from the [fold mean squared errors of $g$](#def-fold-mse-indexed):

$$
\cvseof{g} \eqdef \frac{\hSD{\foldmseof{1}{g}, \ldots, \foldmseof{k}{g}}}{\sqrt{k}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se-indexed}

:::
